referenceFunction.generalComment: This dataset describes the shredding of the used internal combustion engine (ICE) of a passenger car. The entries are given on a per kg basis. The original data has been collected for an ICE with a weight of approximately 275kg. The infrastructure and emission data is based on the e-waste shredding dataset which is based on literature. The output scrap and waste material quantities are derived from the respective ICE production dataset. The materialization of the motor is divided in 5 main fractions: scrap steel, scrap Aluminium, scrap Copper, scrap plastics and a shredding residue. These are the output waste flows of the process.The details concerning the materialization of the ICE trated in this dataset are described in Althaus and Gauch "Vergleichende Oekobilanz der Elektromobilität: Elektromobilität bersus konventionelle Mobilität mit Bio- und fossilen Treibstoffen".; UUID: e05efc01-a536-3337-a408-aa2241f2fbe9
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: The dataset takes as input the used internal combustion engine and includes the treatment facility. This dataset returns the scrap fractions going to the specific recycling facilities and the emissions produced during the treatment process.

referenceFunction.name: Disposal, internal combustion engine, for passenger car

geography.text: Data from European studies, values used as global average data.

technology.text: Modern Shredder facility with 2 shredder, 2 magnetic separation & 2 Eddy-current separation steps. The shredded ICE corresponds to modern average technology.
